description: Checks an IPv4 mail-sending address against the SpamEatingMonkey DNS blocklist (bl.spameatingmonkey.net) through public DNS. A listed address returns its 127.0.0.x return code; an unlisted one returns no record. Listings change often; this is a point-in-time answer. Choose this tool for: Checks an IPv4 mail-sending address against. Close alternatives on this server: security_barracuda_reputation (Checks an IPv4 mail-sending address against the Barracuda); security_blocklist_de (Checks an IPv4 address against the Blocklist.de 'all' list). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
